demos.title: Demos
demos.lede: Each demo runs the built SDK from dist/ in your browser. Window demos open a popup, so allow popups for this site.

sections.title: Control Harmoneasy
sections.intro: HarmonEasy listens by default through its audioBus Protocol Input. Press Start inside the embedded app to enable audio; the remote connects automatically.

demos.title: Remote control without pairing
demos.description: Full remote: keyboard, drums, controllers, transport, presets, every discovered command, property and interface control, plus MIDI feedback. No pairing or manual connection setup.

demos.title: Step through a song
demos.description: Press Start, then use any note or the remote Next note button to advance the song.

demos.title: Remote playground
demos.description: A ready-made HarmonEasy setup for testing remote MIDI and application control.

demos.title: Pairing codes and retained state
demos.description: The popup did not choose its peer, so it shows a code. Enter it to connect, then watch tempo state arrive with the subscription and follow changes.

demos.title: Two peers, symmetric commands
demos.description: Open a second window, discover its commands and set its tempo. Both windows expose the same command.

demos.title: MIDI and command destination
demos.description: A receiver for Harmoneasy's audioBus Protocol Output: notes, UMP, tempo commands, panic and patches, with optional sound. Open it from the Output by entering this page's examples/receiver.html address.

demos.title: Connect over a MIDI port
demos.description: For cross-origin isolated apps that cannot reach each other's windows. Create a loopback MIDI port, open this page in two tabs on any origins, optionally share a secret to encrypt the port, and set each other's tempo over SysEx.

sections.title: In-memory peers
sections.intro: These run the Node examples unchanged with an in-memory transport and show their console output.

demos.title: Connect, discover, subscribe, set
demos.description: Two applications exchange identity, list commands, read state and receive a tempo change event.

demos.title: MIDI 2 and properties
demos.description: Negotiated UMP with exact high-resolution words, a capability bundle, and property discovery and writes.
